title: Recovery
summary: Rescue a failing SD card or stick, test one before trusting it, copy and pack files: ddrescue, testdisk, f3, smartmontools and the rest.
consent: These tools read and write raw storage. ddrescue and testdisk can overwrite a disk if pointed at the wrong one: read their prompts. Install the kit only while you need it.
notes: An offline box has no way to fetch these when the card starts failing: keep the kit cached (Library → Toolkits) so it installs from the cache.
f3write and f3read show a fake or failing card in a few minutes; ddrescue copies what a failing card still gives, in passes, into an image a new card can be written from.
smartctl reads SMART data from USB disks that give it; SD cards do not.
